create_dataframe_from_loggers: create a DataFrame from a list of logger objects by concatenating their data with experiment IDs as keys
create_dataframe_from_stash: create a DataFrame from a list of stash dictionaries and set specified columns as the index
plot_matplotlib_grouped_lines: plot grouped line charts using matplotlib by grouping a DataFrame on a column and plotting x versus y
plot_holoviews_curves: plot interactive curve overlays using holoviews by converting a DataFrame into a Dataset and overlaying curves by group
summarize_plotting_util: summarize the plotting utility module that provides functions for converting loggers and stash data to DataFrames and plotting with matplotlib or holoviews
